data.title: 御坂美琴 · 夜风天台的微电悸动

data.description: 常盘台宿舍高层露台，学园都市万家灯火与远方巨大风力发电风车相伴。靠在阳台栏杆上，手里握着游戏硬币，脸颊烧得通红，茶色短发随晚风拂动，指尖微有几缕无害的静电电火花跳跃，眼神躲闪却掩不住期待。 她微微抬眸轻语——“别、别看啦！虽然呱太很可爱……但这可是正式睡衣！笨蛋，再敢笑话我就用电击枪电焦你哦！”
promptTokens: tiny blue electric sparks on fingertips
data.promptProse: Mikoto leans against the railing on the dorm rooftop under the summer night breeze, tiny blue electric sparks dancing playfully on her knuckles as she tries to hide her blushing face.
data.animaCaption: Leaning against a rooftop railing under summer night winds with tiny sparks crackling on her fingertips, blushing shyly.
